Package frc.robot.alerter

Class Led.Mode

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.alerter.Led.Mode
Enclosing class:
Led
public static class Led.Mode extends Object
Represents a LED display mode that defines how LEDs should behave. Each mode encapsulates a specific behavior pattern that can be applied to LED strips.

This class uses the command pattern to encapsulate LED behaviors as reusable modes. The behavior is defined as a Consumer function that operates on an LED instance.

Available modes include:

  • Solid color display
  • Off (all LEDs turned off)
  • Rainbow color pattern
  • Blinking pattern
